newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose slightly to 1.263 billion yuan from 1.162 billion yuan with the seven-day contract the most active.
Traders said the rates fell on thin volume today because a technical correction on the domestic A share markets made securities houses borrow less money on the interbank market.
Both Shanghai and Shenzhen A share indices fell on Wednesday on the correction.
"Short-term financial centres did less business because of the correction on the A share markets," said one trader. "This made trading volume thin on the interbank market."
The centres are money brokerages run by the central bank.
Traders said the interbank market would continue to be affected by the A share market performance in the short term.
